title: Hold a commercial activity permit for a recreation area
what: Carry on trade or commerce, such as commercial tours, in a Territory park or reserve only under a permit from the Parks and Wildlife Commission.

laws.title: Territory Parks and Wildlife Conservation By-laws 1984 (NT)

sources.title: Territory Parks and Wildlife Conservation By-laws 1984 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not in a park or reserve carry on trade or commerce except in accordance with a permit issued by the Commission
